ESMA publishes guidelines on crypto-asset marketing communications

The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has today published its final guidelines on marketing communications under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA).

The guidelines apply to crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) and issuers of asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens. They cover:

  • Clarity and fairness of marketing claims
  • Risk warnings, including a minimum font size requirement
  • Use of past performance data

ESMA expects national competent authorities to apply the guidelines from the date of publication in all official EU languages.

Next steps

A consultation on further technical standards will open in Q1 2027. See the MiCA hub for background.
